content: अभय {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ ब˚</sab>] Free from fear or danger, secure, safe; वैराग्यमेवाभयम् <ls>Bh. 3. 35</ls>. .{@-यः@} [न भयं यस्मात्] .²1 An epithet of the Supreme Being, or knowledge concerning that being. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²3 One devoid of all worldly possessions. .²4 One who fearlessly executes scriptural commandments. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a Yoga (conjuncture or time) favourable to a march or expedition. .²6 A refuge-offering pose of the hand of an image; <ls>Māna. 12. 120-21</ls>. See अभयमुद्रा. .{@-या@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (हरीतकी, <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>हिरडा</ns>). .²2 A form of the goddess Durgā. .{@-यम्@} .²1 Absence or removal of fear. .²2 Security, safety, protection from fear or danger. मया तस्याभयं दत्तम् <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; अभयस्य हि यो दाता <ls>Ms. 8. 303</ls>; <ls>Ś. 2. 17</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a sacrificial hymn. .²4 The root of a fragrant grass (वीरणमूलम्, उशीरम्).
